description: Every acceptance criterion in done-contract.md must map to a check or a human gate in its own Coverage table (SKILL.md process step 8: 'A criterion mapped to neither will not be enforced'). Guards against a done-contract.md shipped with a silently uncovered criterion. Acceptance criteria live in done-contract.md, not spec.md, since the merge that put them next to the checks that enforce them.

given.scenario: Fixture done-contract.md has 3 numbered acceptance criteria; its own coverage table only maps criteria 1 and 2, leaving criterion 3 ('unauthenticated caller returns 401') untraceable to anything.
